overview.description: A letter of intent is worth exactly what the person signing it risks by signing. Most are worth nothing. Some are worth a round.
objectives: Structure a design partnership that gets you data rather than a logo
Write an LOI that a procurement department will actually let through
Convert a pilot to a contract, which is a different sale from the pilot itself

steps.intro: A letter of intent is worth exactly what the person signing it risks by signing. Most are worth nothing. Some are worth a round.
instructions: For each pipeline account: name the economic buyer and the technical buyer separately.
Define what the pilot must show for them to buy, in their words.
Agree the success criteria in writing before the pilot starts, not after.

submission.description: Produce the Design Partner Pipeline and log it against this module in Homeroom. Done means the artefact exists, not that you read the page.
